highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.5 collects compatibility fixes for Apple and WinUI consumers on the maintained v3 line.
highlights_body: It aligns Apple target frameworks with current .NET guidance, restores the WinUI Projection assembly for .NET 9, and carries the supporting release-line fixes needed to keep older platforms building cleanly.

bullets.detail: The WinUI Projection assembly is packaged again so .NET 9 consumers no longer hit a missing-DLL failure when applications start.
The v3 line now uses 26.0 Apple TFMs for libraries and unversioned TFMs for app projects, matching the layout used by current SDKs and newer SkiaSharp releases.
The servicing branch also picks up the compatibility work needed to keep ANGLE, WASM 2.0.6, Tizen SDK and Alpine builds healthy for downstream consumers still validating those targets.

contributor_summaries.drasticactions: Backported the Apple 26.0 library TFMs and unversioned app TFMs to keep the v3 release line aligned with current SDK expectations
